title: Reduced Vandermonde row bijection
statement: For nonnegative integers $k$ and $\ell$, there is a bijection between the indices $0\le t<\lfloor k/2\rfloor\ell+1$ and the set consisting of one distinguished element together with pairs $(i,r)$ satisfying $0\le i<\lfloor k/2\rfloor$ and $0\le r<\ell$.
